name: Vector-Matrix-Matrix (VMM) Factorization
definition: A factorization technique for light field tensors using core factors (vector and matrix) and basis factors (matrix) to compactly model radiance and geometry, where a factor serves as core factors capturing multilinear interactions and basis factors are located at position x.
summary: VMM factorization compactly represents light field tensors by decomposing probes into shared core factors and probe-specific basis factors, distinguishing itself from standard CP decomposition via this hybrid structure.
